description: This file implements the PacFileDecider class responsible for selecting and fetching PAC (Proxy Auto-Config) scripts, handling fallback mechanisms, and managing network requests related to proxy configuration in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: PacFileDecider
classes.description: Manages the process of determining and fetching the appropriate PAC script, including fallback strategies and network request handling.

classes.name: PacFileDecider::PacSource
classes.description: Represents a source for PAC files, such as WPAD DHCP, WPAD DNS, or a custom URL, and provides logging parameters.

classes.name: PacFileDataWithSource
classes.description: Holds the PAC file data along with its source information.

methods.name: BuildPacSourcesFallbackList
methods.description: Constructs the list of fallback PAC sources based on the current proxy configuration.

methods.name: DetermineURL
methods.description: Determines the effective URL for fetching the PAC script based on the source type.

methods.name: current_pac_source
methods.description: Returns the current PAC source being processed.

methods.name: OnIOCompletion
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous network I/O operations.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing different states of PAC script fetching and verification.

methods.name: DoWait
methods.description: Handles waiting periods before proceeding to the next step.

methods.name: DoWaitComplete
methods.description: Completes the wait state and determines next steps.

methods.name: DoQuickCheck
methods.description: Performs a quick DNS check to determine PAC script source availability.

methods.name: DoQuickCheckComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of the quick DNS check.

methods.name: DoFetchPacScript
methods.description: Initiates fetching of the PAC script from the current source.

methods.name: DoFetchPacScriptComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of the PAC script fetch.

methods.name: DoVerifyPacScript
methods.description: Performs heuristic verification of the fetched PAC script.

methods.name: DoVerifyPacScriptComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of PAC script verification and updates configuration.

methods.name: TryToFallbackPacSource
methods.description: Attempts fallback to the next PAC source upon failure.

methods.name: GetStartState
methods.description: Determines the initial state for the processing loop.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing PAC script fetch and processing operations.
